name: Shakti psychic design (untested): modulated 40 Hz frontal, then occipital
origin: Todd Murphy (Shakti software; extrapolation from Persinger-lab papers)
summary: Murphy's proposed Shakti design for telepathy: the modulated 40 Hz signal over both frontal lobes, then over both occipital lobes. The 20 min per phase are this project's choice; Murphy gives no durations. He bases the design on reported 15 to 25 ms front-to-back phase shifts in brain waves and writes that 'None of the procedures described on this page have been tested yet'.
setting: Practise telepathy or remote-viewing exercises (Murphy). For a fair test, judge results blind, e.g. with the app's Photo-target trial guide.
schedule: The vendor's general Shakti rules: at most every 72 h or once a week, never on consecutive days; a series of 3 or 6 sessions, then a 21-day break.
notes: The vendor proposes 'a session design in which the modulated 40hz signal is applied first over the frontal lobes, followed by the occipital lobes', says it 'could enhance telepathic perception' and adds: 'None of the procedures described on this page have been tested yet.' (psychic.htm). It gives no durations. This program plays 20 min on four frontal coils (Fp1, F3, Fp2, F4), then 20 min on four occipital coils above the bony ridge at the back of the head (O1, PO3, O2, PO4). Each group carries one signal; the switch is abrupt. The 20 min per phase and the sites are this project's choices. The signal moves from front to back once, between the phases; no sweep in 15 to 25 ms steps is played. The vendor's file is not published and no parameters are given. It is rebuilt as a continuous 40 Hz sine whose phase swings 3 rad ahead of and behind a steady 40 Hz every 2 s (about 38.5 to 41.5 Hz), in 1-ms points; the modulation is this project's choice. The occipital-only design is murphy-shakti-psi-rv-untested-occipital. Field strength: the vendor calibrates this signal at 10 mG (1 uT) 'when measured from one coil' (obe45_consent.htm). This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. The default 1 uT there is about 56 uT at the coil face, well above the vendor's calibration. Support: none for this design. The lab reports behind it (Persinger 2002, one subject; Persinger 2003 and 2010, paired subjects) have not been independently repeated. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). The vendor says blurry vision is possible in principle, though not reported (bi_occipital.htm): stop if your sight changes. Do not use results for decisions about real people, places or money. Not for people with epilepsy; stop on distress.
